items.title: In distress
items.ar: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ، وَرَبُّ الأَرْضِ، وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
items.tr: La ilaha illallahul-ʿAzimul-Halim, la ilaha illallahu Rabbul-ʿArshil-ʿAzim, la ilaha illallahu Rabbus-samawati wa Rabbul-ardi wa Rabbul-ʿArshil-Karim.
items.en: There is no god but Allah, the Magnificent, the Forbearing. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the Mighty Throne. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth and Lord of the Noble Throne.

items.title: Setting out on a journey
items.ar: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ
items.tr: Subhanalladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila Rabbina lamunqalibun.
items.en: Glory to Him who has subjected this to us, and we could never have accomplished it. And indeed to our Lord we will return.

items.title: Leaving the house
items.ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ
items.tr: Bismillah, tawakkaltu ʿalallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
items.en: In the name of Allah, I rely upon Allah, and there is no might nor power except with Allah.

items.title: Entering the masjid
items.en: O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy.

items.title: Leaving the masjid
items.en: O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty.

items.title: When rain falls
items.notes: Bukhari’s wording is these two words alone; the longer “Allahumma sayyiban nafiʿa” is from other routes.

items.title: Visiting the sick
items.ar: لاَ بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
items.tr: La ba’sa, tahurun in sha’ Allah.
items.en: No harm, it is a purification, if Allah wills.

items.title: Asking for a cure
items.ar: أَذْهِبِ الْبَاسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، اشْفِ وَأَنْتَ الشَّافِي لاَ شِفَاءَ إِلاَّ شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لاَ يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
items.tr: Adhhibil-ba’sa Rabban-nas, ishfi antash-Shafi, la shifa’a illa shifa’uk, shifa’an la yughadiru saqama.
items.en: Remove the harm, Lord of mankind. Heal — You are the Healer. There is no healing but Your healing, a healing that leaves behind no illness.

items.title: Under the weight of debt
items.tr: Allahumma-kfini bihalalika ʿan haramik, wa aghnini bifadlika ʿamman siwak.
items.en: O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful against what You have forbidden, and enrich me by Your bounty so I need none besides You.

items.title: Anxiety and grief
items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
items.tr: Allahumma inni aʿudhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-ʿajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa dalaʿid-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal.
items.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and grief, from incapacity and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, from the burden of debt and from being overpowered by men.

items.title: Seeking guidance — Istikharah
items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلاَ أَقْدِرُ وَتَعْلَمُ وَلاَ أَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتَ عَلاَّمُ الْغُيُوبِ
items.tr: Allahumma inni astakhiruka biʿilmik, wa astaqdiruka biqudratik, wa as’aluka min fadlikal-ʿazim, fa innaka taqdiru wa la aqdir, wa taʿlamu wa la aʿlam, wa anta ʿallamul-ghuyub.
items.en: O Allah, I seek Your guidance by Your knowledge, and Your power by Your might, and I ask You of Your immense bounty. For You are able and I am not, You know and I do not, and You are the Knower of all that is hidden.
items.benefits: Prayed as two rakʿahs outside the obligatory prayers, then this said.

items.title: When angry
items.en: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Shaytan.

items.title: Lying down to sleep
items.en: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

items.title: On waking
items.ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا
items.tr: Al-hamdu lillahilladhi ahyana baʿda ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur.
items.en: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after He caused us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.

items.title: For someone who marries
items.tr: Barakallahu lak, wa baraka ʿalayk, wa jamaʿa baynakuma fi khayr.
items.en: May Allah bless you, and send blessings upon you, and join you both in goodness.

items.title: In hardship and toil
items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ عَيْشَ إِلاَّ عَيْشُ الآخِرَهْ
items.en: O Allah, there is no life but the life of the Hereafter.
items.notes: Said by him ﷺ while digging the trench.
